name: claude-bridge
description: Two-way chat between Codex and the Claude Code sessions running on your computer.

interface.shortDescription: Message local Claude Code sessions and get their replies
interface.longDescription: Lets Codex find the Claude Code sessions running on this computer, send them messages, and receive their replies as new turns. It uses Claude Code's local peer messaging, so a Claude session can also message Codex with SendMessage.
defaultPrompt: List the Claude Code sessions on this computer
Ask Claude Code to review my latest change
